aiResearchSummary.text: Notable Labs is focused on developing personalized cancer treatment strategies through drug combination testing. They explore combinations of protein kinase C agonists with steroids or retinoic acids to synergistically increase antigen expression on cancer cells. Additionally, they investigate methods for treating proliferative diseases by targeting novel priming-eligible targets, utilizing compositions comprising priming agents. These efforts aim to enhance the effectiveness of cancer therapies through innovative drug combinations and targeted treatment approaches.
